elapsedBoundaryRegression.trigger: 11 / 86400 day serial converted to 109999999 ticks and displayed 10 seconds before correction. Minute and hour boundaries share the same truncation defect.
elapsedBoundaryRegression.scope: Nearest-tick conversion before existing format precision; both signs, saved/reopened cells, negative sections, formula recalculation, shared text adapters, both PDF worksheet layouts and out-of-range omissions.
elapsedBoundaryRegression.before: 18 new iWork cases failed, 9 controls passed. Actual .NET 8.0.23 and 10.0.12 public probes reproduced ±11s -> ±10s.
elapsedBoundaryRegression.after: Actual public probes show ±11s preserved and 3661.75s still truncates whole seconds. Generated two-page elapsed-boundary PDF inspected: seconds/minutes/hours and both signs retained.

boundaries: Native executable execution qualifies the recorded bounded reading, destination conversion, creation and preservation profiles on macOS arm64. Composed PDF NativeAOT, other architectures, public packages and native hosts require separate evidence.

Numbers rounds whole-second fractional appearance differently from the shared formatter and native Excel. Raw duration seconds, destination day serials, formula caches and explicit format codes are preserved; display approximation remains reported.
Native Excel displays negative hour/minute elapsed values as hash marks while the shared formatter retains a signed duration. This does not establish native Excel display equivalence.
All six composed PDF pages and all three native PDF pages were inspected. Content is complete; width pagination yields six pages versus three native pages, with declared font substitution.
Millisecond/automatic/other duration ranges and additional producer versions remain outside this five-profile source boundary.
